formats: Every entry ships as OGG Vorbis (file) + MP3 (alt), 44.1 kHz. Load in Phaser as [ogg, mp3].
normalization: Music -20 LUFS; wind bed -24/-26 LUFS; quieter ambience layers -28 to -30 LUFS; drone -20 LUFS; voice -16 LUFS (loudnorm); one-shots peak-normalized (SFX -1 dBFS, ambient one-shots -3/-6 dBFS, footsteps -6 dBFS, UI -6/-9 dBFS). Mix with Phaser volume on top.
loops: Loops were made seamless with an equal-power crossfade of the tail into the head (or are the author's own loop files). loop_seam_jump_vs_p99_step < ~1 means no audible click. Prefer the OGG for loops: MP3 adds encoder padding, which can leave a tiny gap at the loop point in some browsers.
license_summary: All CC0 except footsteps/dirt_* (CC-BY 3.0: credit congusbongus + swuing). Nothing NC/ND, no YouTube rips.
